name: UT-HAR
summary: Widely used seven-class clip-level WiFi CSI benchmark containing daily activities and falls.

original.license: Dataset license not stated; official-source fetch only
formats: NumPy payloads stored with CSV filenames

standardization.notes: The source [T,90] processed feature matrix becomes [T,30,1,3]. Preserve signed values and use a diverging display scale. The physical packet rate is not reported, so the 100 Hz task grid is recorded as an assumption rather than measured source metadata.
